baseline_models.mechanism: The prohibition regulates a transfer of nearness, support, and practical oversight into another social body. The address to those who trust makes the allocation of security and reliance, not bare civility, the operative stake.

activation_trace.role: Secure trust supplies the resource that affiliation would redirect toward the prohibited group.
Nearness without an interval turns تولي into installed relational adjacency rather than casual contact.
Taking charge of an affair gives the relation an operative and governing dimension.
Love, support, and alliance provide the direct social force of the prohibited attachment.
The object is a constituted human group, so the attachment has a corporate rather than merely private endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Do not feel friendship toward a disfavored people.
changed_reading.after: Do not install that people as a near, supportive, or governing locus for the believers' trust; ordinary encounter is not yet the تولي being barred.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قد يئسوا من الآخرة كما يئس الكفار
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated root of despair cuts expectation on both sides of the comparison, while الآخرة supplies the dimension of what comes after. The group is marked by a present that can no longer be reorganized by a later horizon.

activation_trace.role: Both occurrences enact the cutting off of hope and bind the compared states through repeated closure.
Afterness supplies the future horizon from which expectation has been severed.
Deferral to a later time makes despair a loss of temporal extension, not only a rejected proposition.

changed_reading.before: They deny or have no hope in the afterlife.
changed_reading.after: Their present social orientation is closed against any consequential later time; the doubled despair depicts a community whose attachments are governed by temporal foreclosure.

baseline_models.mechanism: Covering, burial, and depressed hiddenness form a single spatial field, yet أصحاب preserves companionship and occupancy inside it. The comparison can therefore retain both an outward relation to the buried and an image of unbelief as already enclosed in grave-like expectationlessness.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the epistemic action by which a horizon can be obscured.
Continued companionship prevents the buried from becoming mere objects and keeps the simile relational.
Burial supplies the literal terminal boundary across which expectation appears unable to pass.
Depression and hiddenness thicken the grave into a spatial model of occluded futurity.
Cut-off hope supplies the shared state connecting the group, unbelief, and the grave boundary.

changed_reading.before: The final clause offers one simple example of unbelievers despairing of the dead.
changed_reading.after: The clause keeps two readings in play: living unbelievers expect nothing from buried companions, while unbelief itself is pictured as inhabiting a covered, grave-like closure; أصحاب keeps relation alive in both.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first context ayah locates affection in a channel that can be concealed beneath an announced identity. Its hidden/manifest contrast activates the focus ayah's covering and grave-depth images: prohibited affiliation can operate underground before it becomes a public alliance.

activation_trace.role: Love and support anchor the covert channel back in the focus prohibition.
Covering gives the hidden attachment a focus-ayah image without making secrecy itself equal unbelief.
Depressed hiddenness spatializes a relation operating below its visible declaration.
Concealing something inwardly supplies the private location of the affectionate transfer.
Cover and concealment reinforce that the attachment may be structurally real while socially unseen.
Manifest disclosure supplies the contrasting surface against which concealed affiliation is detected.

structural_cues: 60:1 repeats affection at words 11 and 35, then contrasts what is hidden with what is announced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated affection plus concealment and disclosure; I infer a hidden allocation of trust beneath public identity. A live alternative is that the contrast serves only divine omniscience and does not characterize تولي itself.

changed_reading.before: The verse prohibits an overtly declared alliance.
changed_reading.after: It also interrogates subterranean flows of affection, confidence, and aid that make another group function as an ally before any public declaration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The conditional scene of gaining hold, extending hands, and extending tongues turns hostility into latent capacity awaiting opportunity. This strengthens the baseline reading of تولي as granting proximity to a social actor whose embodied power and speech can become instruments of harm.

activation_trace.role: Proximity is the access condition through which latent coercive capacity could become effective.
Intensified displeasure gains a socially legible correlate in the context's threatened actions.
Obtaining and taking hold supplies the conditional moment when hostile capacity acquires purchase.
The extending hand converts inward enmity into outward reach and action.
The hand as force makes the bodily image function as coercive capacity.
The organ of speech supplies a second instrument through which hostility reaches the believers.
What causes injury names the result toward which hand and tongue are extended.

structural_cues: 60:2 begins with a conditional acquisition of access and then coordinates hands, tongues, and the wish that the believers disbelieve.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conditional capture and embodied extensions of force and speech; I infer that dangerous تولي grants access to a coercive network. A live alternative is that 60:2 only predicts conduct and does not define the prohibited relation in 60:13.

changed_reading.before: The group is avoided simply because it bears a negative divine evaluation.
changed_reading.after: The evaluation has an observable social mechanism: proximity can expose believers to a counterparty whose force, speech, and desire to undo faith become active when it gains hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first makes distance, enmity, and aversion explicit, then presents affection as a state God can bring about between former enemies. That sequence revises the focus group's anger-marked condition from an immutable essence into a serious present boundary with a live route of transformation.

activation_trace.role: Intense displeasure anchors the current negative condition whose duration is being tested.
Love and alliance are the focus relation that the context first refuses and then leaves transformable.
Disavowal as active distancing supplies the firm initial boundary.
Manifest enmity moves the separation from an inward attitude into an openly legible relation.
Psychic aversion supplies the affective intensity of the initial rupture.
Making something enter a new state supplies the transformation arrow rather than mere discovery of hidden affection.
Actual enmity names the prior relation out of which a different state may be made.
Affection is the new relation that can replace enmity without weakening the current prohibition.
Effective capacity grounds the promised relational reversal as possible rather than sentimental.

structural_cues: 60:4 declares separation and enmity until faith, while 60:7 explicitly imagines affection being made between those who had been enemies.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an initial rupture followed by state-making, affection, and capacity; I infer that the anger-marked category is condition-sensitive and reversible. A live alternative is that reversal occurs only after a complete change of religious allegiance, not through reconciliation while difference remains.

changed_reading.before: The angered people form a permanently hateful class.
changed_reading.after: The boundary is firm under the present condition but does not authorize ontological hatred: the same relational field remains open to a divinely enabled change from enmity to affection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired permissions and prohibitions classify relations by conduct: noncombatants and non-expellers remain recipients of expansive goodness and equity, whereas fighting, expulsion, and backing expulsion mark the prohibited side. This sharply narrows تولي away from indiscriminate social coldness.

activation_trace.role: Alliance and support are the relation whose scope the paired context ayahs delimit.
Withholding prohibition establishes that difference alone does not trigger the focus boundary.
Mutual combat supplies one concrete conduct threshold rather than a group essence.
Forced movement outside the home supplies the second conduct threshold.
Connecting goodness toward the nonhostile remains positively available across the boundary.
Equity supplies a required mode of cross-boundary dealing, preventing تولي from swallowing justice.
Giving one's back as support identifies active reinforcement of expulsion as part of the hostile mechanism.
The repeated outward driving makes dispossession, not mere alterity, the recurring boundary marker.

structural_cues: 60:8 and 60:9 use matched openings but divide nonfighters from fighters, expellers, and those who support expulsion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a conduct-based contrast plus positive birr and qist; I infer that تولي is aligned backing of a coercive relation, not every kind act. A live alternative is that the classification is a narrow exception and does not exhaust the semantic range of alliance.

changed_reading.before: No positive relation may cross the group boundary.
changed_reading.after: Goodness and equity may cross it; what may not cross is allegiance that gives nearness, backing, or governing support to a relation organized through combat and expulsion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence joins exemplary orientation to hope in God and the later day, then immediately names turning away. Against the focus ayah's doubled despair, hope and despair become rival temporal engines that organize present allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Cut-off hope anchors the negative temporal engine in the focus ayah.
Alliance is the present social output whose temporal motivation is being inferred.
The heart's reaching toward what is hoped for provides the positive counterforce to despair.
The later horizon gives hope a temporal destination matching the horizon denied in the focus.
Turning away supplies the adjacent social motion that follows the context's statement of hope.

structural_cues: 60:6 places hope in God and the later day directly before a clause about turning away; 60:13 reverses hope into repeated despair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hope, the later horizon, turning away, and doubled despair; I infer that future expectation organizes present attachment. A live alternative is that these are adjacent audience descriptions without a causal relation.

changed_reading.before: Despair is only a belief held by the prohibited group.
changed_reading.after: Despair is also an attachment-producing condition: when consequential futurity closes, immediate protective alliances can become governing substitutes, while hope releases allegiance toward a later horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The migration case tests belonging, refuses return, dissolves marital permissibility, releases protective bonds, and still accounts for expenditures under judgment. It activates تولي as governance of adhesive legal and intimate ties across a hostile boundary, not merely management of feeling.

activation_trace.role: Oversight of affairs anchors the focus prohibition in institutional control of bonds.
Legalized allegiance through kinship and status supplies a close analogue for the bonds being reassigned.
Movement from one abode to another initiates a change in the migrants' governing social location.
A test that reveals what is in the heart mediates the recognition of changed belonging.
Return to the prior state is explicitly blocked, making the boundary directional.
The lifting or absence of permissibility marks the old intimate bond as legally dissolved.
Money going out preserves material claims even while the relational bond is severed.
Holding and confining names the retention of a tie that the verse orders released.
A bond that holds, protects, and prevents supplies the adhesive structure no longer to be retained.
Judgment between parties turns separation into an adjudicated process rather than arbitrary repudiation.

structural_cues: 60:10 moves in sequence from migration and examination to non-return, dissolved marital status, reciprocal reimbursement, and judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies migration, tested identity, unbinding, payments, and adjudication; I infer that تولي includes retaining a bond that subjects believers to a hostile authority. A live alternative is that the sequence is confined to marriage law and should not generalize to patronage.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse asks only for emotional distance.
changed_reading.after: It can govern the release of intimate and legal bonds that carry hostile authority, while requiring transparent adjudication and preservation of the other side's material claims.

context_deltas.mechanism: A spouse who has passed beyond recovery creates a broken pair, yet the response is substitution and equivalent repayment. This legal repair contrasts with the focus ayah's absolute cutting off of hope: worldly affiliation may end without making loss nihilistic or erasing residual obligation.

activation_trace.role: Cut-off hope provides the terminal state against which a reparable worldly loss is contrasted.
Companionship anchors the comparison in the persistence and rupture of human relational bonds.
Passing beyond reach supplies a worldly analogue to expectation encountering a hard limit.
A counterpart joined to its pair identifies the specific relation that has been broken.
Substitution and guarantee provide a reparative response after the relational loss.
Equivalence constrains repair to a measured correspondence rather than retaliatory excess.
The outgoing expenditure is the material residue that remains recoverable after the pair is lost.

structural_cues: 60:11 orders an equivalent transfer to the one whose spouse has gone, converting relational loss into a measured communal claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unreached loss, a broken pair, substitution, equivalence, and expenditure; I infer an anti-despair repair protocol. A live alternative is that these terms express only financial settlement without commenting on the focus ayah's despair.

changed_reading.before: Severing a prohibited affiliation means abandoning every consequence of the severed relation.
changed_reading.after: A bond may be ended while its losses are still carried and repaired by the community; boundary does not require indifference, confiscation, or imitation of the despair condemned in 60:13.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pledge scene supplies a positive architecture after prohibited allegiance: belonging is enacted through a public covenant, refusal of rival participation, and obedience bounded by recognized good. The focus's negative لا تتولوا is thus paired with a constructive relocation of loyalty.

activation_trace.role: Trust and security provide the positive substance that a new covenant must hold.
Taking charge of affairs makes allegiance an organized relation needing a legitimate replacement.
The pledge of obedience supplies a public act that constitutes the replacement bond.
Refusal of divine partnership places an exclusivity boundary at the covenant's foundation.
Departure from obedience identifies the covenantal failure the pledge undertakes to avoid.
Recognized good limits obedience by a norm the self, reason, and law can acknowledge.

structural_cues: 60:12 begins and ends with pledge language and places a bounded list of obligations between its two occurrences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a public pledge, exclusive worship, bounded obedience, and recognized good; I infer that prohibited patronage is answered by reconstituting belonging through accountable covenant. A live alternative is that the pledge regulates individual conduct without serving as a model of collective affiliation.

changed_reading.before: The verse only removes believers from a social relation.
changed_reading.after: Its removal has a positive counterpart: trust is relocated into a public, bounded covenant whose authority is answerable to recognized good rather than private patronage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates material branches of قوم and غضب rather than their ordinary senses. It remains anchored in the exact group, anger, and تولي construction and yields a coherent support mechanism. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, never as a lexical replacement for 'people' or 'anger.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لا تتولوا قومًا غضب الله عليهم

activation_trace.role: Entrusting affairs supplies the act of making another formation operationally load-bearing.
A support by which something stands turns the group into a possible social infrastructure.
Hard, compact rock gives the anger-marked formation a resistant material quality.

changed_reading.before: Do not ally with a group upon whom there is anger.
changed_reading.after: Do not make a hardened, anger-shaped social formation the load-bearing structure on which the believing community conducts its affairs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The image of milk returning is form-distant from ordinary عسى and should not be translated into 60:7. It remains worth carrying because 60:7 itself moves from enmity to made affection while 60:13 doubles cut-off hope. Render it, if at all, as a qualified material analogy for relational flow resuming after apparent depletion.

activation_trace.role: Cut-off hope supplies the apparent depletion against which renewed flow becomes surprising.
Love and alliance anchor the material analogy in the focus ayah's relational field.
Hope for milk's return supplies an image of a nourishing flow resuming after cessation.
State-making supplies the causal transition from depleted relation to renewed affection.
Affection names the relational flow that may return.

changed_reading.before: Present hostility and despair describe a socially exhausted relation with no remaining yield.
changed_reading.after: Even while current patronage is barred, the relation need not be imagined as permanently dry: affection may be made to flow again, so believers must not answer another group's despair by adopting despair about that group.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain activation from the cut-and-stitch branch of فري beside its direct fabrication branch. It remains anchored because the focus concerns joining oneself to a people and 60:12 juxtaposes pledge with fabricated falsehood. Downstream prose should label the stitch as a reader-supplied analogy, not claim that يفترينه lexically means communal sewing here.

activation_trace.role: Nearness without a gap supplies the joining operation whose legitimacy is at stake.
The structure by which something stands lets communal belonging be pictured as constructed fabric.
A public pledge supplies the legitimate joining of persons into accountable belonging.
A lie that stuns its bearer or hearer supplies the deceptive material used in a counterfeit bond.
Cutting in order to mend or stitch supplies the anomalous construction image.
Fabricating a lie keeps the stitch image tethered to the actual false-making action in the context.

changed_reading.before: Affiliation is a preexisting sentiment one either has or refuses.
changed_reading.after: Belonging can be actively stitched: public covenant constructs an accountable bond, while concealed or fabricated claims can counterfeit the joining of a person to a social body.

strongest_changes: Tawalli shifted from generic friendship to the allocation of proximity, support, trust, and governing authority.
The permission of birr and qist toward noncombatants separated principled boundary from indiscriminate hostility.
The movement from declared enmity to possible affection made the anger-marked condition serious but transformable rather than ontological.
Migration, unbinding, reimbursement, and equivalent repair showed that severed affiliation can preserve justice and residual obligation.
The hope/despair polarity made future expectation an engine of present attachment rather than a detached doctrinal topic.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated despair, the covering-and-grave cluster, reversible affection, and the legal vocabulary of holding, bonds, judgment, and compensation made 60:13 function simultaneously as a boundary rule, a diagnosis of foreclosed futurity, and a warning not to reproduce despair while enforcing separation. Material branch activations added contained images of load-bearing hardness, renewed flow, and social stitching.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact syntactic force of من أصحاب القبور leaves the direction and population of the final comparison partly open.
The degree to which تولي in 60:13 extends from intimate alliance into formal governance or legal status remains inferential.
The 60:7 reversal may require a prior change of faith, or it may authorize a broader expectation of reconciliation.
The rock, returning-milk, and stitching readings are productive branch analogies, not proposed lexical substitutions.
